policy: Reference photographs remain in Review, outside Assets. Authored geometry and surface functions are original. The vetted Poly Haven Potted Plant 04 model and 1K textures are the only new third-party game assets in this pass, under CC0. No purchased asset or image-generation service was used.

references.name: Garden rose, Mayra's Bridal Pink
references.author: Alexandra Farms
references.license: Copyrighted reference only, not redistributed in game
references.observed: Rounded overlapping cupped petals and denser rolled centre.
references.unverified: Complete petal underside and exact geometry.
references.interpretation: 16 authored petals with three curved rings and three bloom variants; not a scan.

references.name: Oxford stand-collar shirt
references.author: MUJI
references.observed: Plain woven cloth, front placket, chest pocket, narrow collar.
references.unverified: Hanging garment drape; reference is worn by a person.
references.interpretation: Original hanging forms and coarse stitched seams, no brand marks.

references.name: Linea Classic S commercial espresso machine
references.author: La Marzocco
references.observed: Metal panels, separate group heads, knobs, gauge and cup rail.
references.unverified: Exact roughness, internal parts or operating simulation.
references.interpretation: Original generic equipment, shared brushed steel and ceramic/paper finishes.

references.name: Potted rubber plant
references.author: Margaret Shear / NC State Extension Plant Toolbox
references.license: Photograph credited CC BY-SA 4.0 on source; viewed as reference only and not included in game
references.observed: Elliptical glossy leaves at different heights on upright stems, thick central ribs, irregular crown.
references.unverified: Exact cultivar, full back/underside and scale.
references.interpretation: Low-poly authored nursery plant with 11 leaves, three shared leaf variations and shared stem mesh.

references.name: Potted peace lily
references.author: UF/IFAS Gardening Solutions
references.license: No reuse license verified; visual reference only, excluded from game
references.observed: Arching basal clump, long ribbed leaves, white spathes and pale upright spadices.
references.unverified: Exact cultivar, dimensions and photographic surface properties.
references.interpretation: 13 leaves with curved petioles, two authored spathes; reduced density for gameplay silhouette and draw budget.

assets.name: Cupped roses V9
assets.author: Project-authored
assets.modification: 20-sample boundaries and three radial spans per petal, three shared variants, 1952 vertices/head. A family-specific 2000-vertex batching exception keeps these heads in material sectors; other mesh limits stay unchanged.

assets.name: Botanical potted foliage V2
assets.author: Project-authored
assets.modification: Two growth habits, six shared 306-vertex leaf meshes, two stem meshes, softer leaf edges and upright young leaves. Original compost and vein textures.

assets.name: Laundry V4 surface and seams
assets.author: Project-authored
assets.modification: More curved torso/shoulder/sleeve samples, cloth-following pockets/buttons and shared seam meshes, original woven normal and albedo.

assets.name: Ceramic, paper and steel finish V2
assets.author: Project-authored
assets.license: Original project material and surface functions
assets.location: B1 café/restaurant cups and coffee service equipment
assets.modification: Separate matte paper/fired glaze, subtle shared relief and brushed metal roughness variation.

assets.name: Potted Plant 04
assets.author: James Ray Cock / Poly Haven
assets.modification: Shared FBX mesh normalized to 0.30 m height, slight per-instance yaw/scale. Original 1K diffuse and GL normal. ARM repacked to URP metallic R, occlusion G, smoothness A. Opaque instanced material; no individual collider or runtime scripts.
assets.original_file: Assets/OutOfService/Art/Models/potted_plant_04/ (FBX and 3 original 1K maps retained and checked against official MD5)
assets.selection: Official page lists 6K source faces; Unity import was inspected as 5660 vertices and 8929 triangles, source height 0.27 m. Three instances use one shared mesh/material. Larger 70K/96K candidates were not adopted.
